query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Using a nickel-based alloy or a ceramic material for preparing parts of the dipping and plating equipment can protect it from erosion by liquid aluminum during the hot dip aluminum plating process.
generation.material_initial_state: Components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates are made of a material prone to corrosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum.
generation.intervention: Replace the current material with a nickel-based alloy or a ceramic material.
generation.conditions: High-temperature conditions during the hot dip aluminum plating process.
generation.structural_mediator: Corrosion resistance and high-temperature stability of the material.
generation.mechanism: The nickel-based alloy or ceramic material resists corrosion by liquid aluminum, reducing the erosion of the equipment components.
generation.predicted_outcome: Increased service life of the equipment components due to reduced corrosion.
generation.baseline: Current service life of the equipment components.
generation.boundary: The effectiveness of the nickel-based alloy or ceramic material in withstanding high temperatures and resisting corrosion by liquid aluminum.
generation.uncertainty: The exact increase in service life and the optimal composition of the nickel-based alloy or ceramic material for this specific application.

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative study of equipment components made of the current material versus nickel-based alloy or ceramic material under the same high-temperature conditions.
measurements: Service life of the equipment components
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the service life of the equipment components made of nickel-based alloy or ceramic material is not significantly longer than that of the current material, or if the corrosion rate of the nickel-based alloy or ceramic material is not significantly lower, then the hypothesis is falsified.
